description:
You are one of several procurement officers at a hospital network choosing a vendor for a new patient-records system. Each officer has reviewed different parts of the bids and reference checks.

The options are:
- Vendor A (Quogar Sobre)
- Vendor B (Drahesk Yerweldra)
- Vendor C (Fenlyn Ridax)
- Vendor D (Fenvok Quopol)

Exactly one option is best overall. Which vendor should be selected? Your notes are incomplete: other participants hold information you do not have.

  - Vendor A passed an independent security audit
  - Vendor A offers straightforward contract exit terms
  - Vendor A currently serves 3 hospital clients
Vendor B (Drahesk Yerweldra):
  - Vendor B has reported financial difficulties
  - Vendor B has a clear product roadmap
  - Vendor B offers straightforward contract exit terms
  - Vendor B offers 24/7 on-call support
  - Vendor B estimates deployment will take 5 months
